w10_T4_004565: On Monday morning a florist's hub held 122 bouquets, and 47 more arrived before noon. At lunchtime a grower dropped off 18 bouquets. In the afternoon head office loaded that same run onto each of its 4 vans, taking that many bouquets per van. During the evening 514 bouquets were delivered to customers. Overnight the hub repeated the whole operation at 5 depots, handling that many bouquets at each one, and the hub employs 32 people. How many bouquets were handled across the depots?
w10_T4_004570: A canoe centre had 129 buoyancy aids in its hire store. Guests lost 9 aids during the first week. A supplier sent 30 aids, and a hotel donated 40 more. The chain then ordered that same store for each of its 4 centres, needing that many aids per centre. Half of the store is taken up by paddles, and sessions are sold in hours although the safety log is kept in minutes. How many buoyancy aids are needed altogether?
w10_T4_004574: A dance school had 95 pairs of shoes in the costume room, and a donation doubled that number. A parent then added 18 pairs. Half of the pairs were sent to the summer school, and the rest stayed in the costume room. The school ordered 6 new pairs for every pair still in the room. Rehearsals are timed in minutes although the timetable is published in hours. How many pairs does the school's order come to?
w10_T4_004579: On Tuesday morning a printer received 126 reels of paper, and each reel was cut into 4 rolls. Before noon every roll was slit into 7 ribbons. In the afternoon the ribbons were shared equally between the 6 presses, and the evening press is the one being followed. That press then printed 6 tickets from every ribbon in its share. Late that night a partner shop sent over 74 finished tickets. The works covers 700 square metres, and the presses are timed in minutes although the schedule is written in hours. How many tickets does the evening press have?
w10_T4_004580: On Wednesday morning a garage had 219 tyres in the store, and a delivery added 15 more before noon. In the afternoon the supplier sent 3 tyres for every tyre in the store. In the evening the tyres were shared equally between the 3 branches, and the airport branch's share is the one to follow. Overnight head office ordered 4 tyres for every tyre at the airport branch, and the garage has 8 ramps. How many tyres does that order come to?
w10_T4_004581: A tool hire shop had 33 ladders on its rack. A firm that was closing sold it 58 ladders, and an auction added 79 more. A building contract then took 147 ladders away for the season. The shop ordered 7 ladders for every ladder left on the rack. Half of the yard is under cover, and hire is charged in hours although the paperwork is filled in by the minute. How many ladders does the order come to?
w10_T4_004584: A juice bar bought 122 crates of carrots, and each crate held 6 bunches. Wilting spoiled 138 bunches, and a market trader sent over 67 fresh ones. The kitchen used 635 bunches during the month, and a soup stall took 14 more. Half of the cold room is given over to bottles. How many bunches does the juice bar have left?
w10_T4_004585: A school orchestra had 239 sheets of music in its folder. The librarian withdrew 81 sheets that were falling apart. A composer sent 3 new sheets, and 55 sheets went to a partner school. The conductor then had 3 copies made of every sheet in the folder. The orchestra rehearses in hours although the registers are marked in minutes. How many sheets of music are there now?
w10_T4_004588: Emeka grows more garlic than his neighbour Suzy does. He lifted 173 baskets, and a helper brought 19 more. Suzy added 10 baskets from her own plot. Each basket was then broken into 8 bulbs, and every bulb was split into 7 cloves. A wholesaler bought 9229 cloves, and half of Emeka's barn is used for drying. How many cloves does Emeka have left?
w10_T4_004589: Marisa looks after more allotment keys than her colleague Cai does. She started with 108 keys, and 103 were handed out to plot holders. A locksmith then cut 49 new keys. The keys were shared equally between the 6 gates on the site, and the north gate's set is the one being followed. A committee member added 35 keys to that set, and the set was finally split evenly between the 2 wardens, of whom the weekend warden's half is the one counted. How many keys does the weekend warden have?
w10_T4_004591: A groundsman brought 72 rolls of turf onto the pitch, and each roll was cut into 8 strips. Laying the goalmouths used up 295 strips. A supplier delivered 79 strips, a neighbouring club gave 48, and the council sent 7 more. How many strips does the groundsman have now?
w10_T4_004596: On Friday morning a school kitchen had 60 packs of pasta, and each pack made 4 portions. At midday the portions were shared equally between the 3 sittings, and the first sitting is the one being followed. In the afternoon the cook prepared 2 portions for every portion in that sitting. In the evening 53 portions from it were served to the after-school club. How many portions are left for the first sitting?
w10_T4_004602: Fabio harvests more olives than his cousin Nella does. He filled 78 sacks, and each sack was tipped into 8 crates. Every crate was pressed into 4 bottles of oil, and each bottle was decanted into 3 small flasks. Nella added 70 flasks from her own press, and a co-op sent 21 more. Half of Fabio's cellar is below ground. How many flasks does Fabio have?
w10_T4_004603: On Monday morning a brick kiln fired 107 trays, and each tray held 6 bricks. Before noon a lorry delivered 73 loose bricks. In the afternoon the works produced 4 bricks for every brick in the yard. During the evening 869 bricks went to a housing site, and overnight a builder collected 859 more. The yard is 45 metres across. How many bricks are left in the yard?
w10_T4_004606: Amina prints more wallpaper than her partner Gustav does. She started with 163 rolls, and each roll was cut into 7 lengths. A shop bought 512 lengths. The mill then printed 9 lengths for every length she had left. A hotel contract took 2415 lengths, and a chain store finally ordered 8 lengths for every length remaining. The mill has 24 printing tables. How many lengths does the chain store's order come to?
w10_T4_004611: On Saturday morning a market trader had 202 toy cars on his stall, and 11 of them were sold early on. A collector returned 6 cars that were the wrong model. At midday a wholesaler matched the stall exactly, leaving 2 cars for every car on it. In the afternoon a house clearance added 76 cars, and 125 cars were sold before closing. In the evening the wholesaler supplied 9 cars for every car left on the stall. How many cars does the trader have now?
w10_T4_004613: On Thursday morning a pet shop had 77 water bowls, and a delivery added 35 more before noon. At midday a second delivery doubled the number of bowls in the shop. During the afternoon 87 bowls were sold. In the evening head office supplied 8 bowls for every bowl left on the shelf. A customer then returned 32 bowls that were the wrong size. How many bowls does the shop have?
w10_T4_004618: On Monday morning a cannery received 234 sacks of tomatoes, and each sack filled 4 pots. By the afternoon every pot had been divided into 4 tins. In the evening 220 tins failed the seal test and were scrapped. Overnight the plant ran that same order for each of 3 supermarkets, needing that many tins per supermarket. The cannery lists cooking times in minutes although the labels give them in hours. How many tins does the whole order come to?
w10_T4_004619: Priit collects more stamps than his sister Kadri does. He had 177 stamps, and an album sale added 79 more. A swap meeting then doubled his collection. He sold 364 stamps to a dealer, gave half of what was left to Kadri, and kept the rest. A cousin later sent him 5 stamps from abroad. How many stamps does Priit have now?
w10_T4_004622: On Monday morning a flood depot had 237 sandbags, and a lorry brought 70 more before noon. At midday the council tripled the depot's stock. In the early afternoon a partner depot doubled that number again. A volunteer stitched 10 extra bags during the evening. Overnight 1372 sandbags were taken to the riverside, and a farmer returned 7 unused bags. How many sandbags are in the depot now?
w10_T4_004623: Hanna makes more picture frames than her colleague Ivo does. She had 237 frames in her workshop, and a gallery bought 164 of them. Ivo then delivered 55 frames he had built. A department store ordered 5 frames for every frame in the workshop. The frames were shared equally between the store's 5 branches, and the seafront branch's share is the one to follow. The workshop has been open 11 years. How many frames went to the seafront branch?
w10_T4_004626: On Monday morning Ondrej had 199 bundles of reed, more than his neighbour Zsofia had cut. Each bundle was split into 5 thatching sheaves. Before noon 295 sheaves were sold at the yard. In the afternoon the sheaves were split evenly into 2 identical stacks, and the covered stack is the one being followed. In the evening Zsofia added 70 sheaves to that stack. Overnight the stack was shared equally between the 4 roofers on the job, and one roofer's share is the one counted. How many sheaves does that roofer have?
w10_T4_004627: On Sunday morning Freya had 61 raffle prizes on the table, more than her co-organiser Sam had gathered. Before noon 28 prizes were claimed. At midday a shop donated 56 prizes, and Sam brought 51 more in the early afternoon. Later a bakery added 47 prizes. During the evening draw 127 prizes were handed out. How many prizes are left on the table?
w10_T4_004629: A quarry loaded 177 wagons, and each wagon carried 7 blocks of stone. A second train then doubled the number of blocks at the yard. A cathedral order took 1197 blocks, and a bridge job took 664 more. A supplier returned 8 blocks that were the wrong size. Half of the yard floods in winter, and the quarry measures its stone in tonnes although the invoices are written in kilograms. How many blocks are in the yard now?
w10_T4_004631: An ice rink had 48 pairs of skates in the hire rack. 1 pair was broken beyond repair, 12 pairs were sent away for sharpening, and 26 pairs went out to a school group. The rink then ordered 6 pairs for every pair still on the rack. A fault meant 23 pairs of that delivery had to be sent back. The rink opens 300 days a year. How many pairs from that order did the rink keep?
